newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco says candle caused fire in Casablanca.
newsitem.headline: Morocco says candle caused fire in Casablanca.

text.p: A fire in a Casablanca shanty town on Sunday night that injured 96 people was caused by a candle falling over, the official Moroccan news agency MAP said on Tuesday.
A candle toppled over during a fight involving a man, his wife and their friends and started the fire at the Ben Msick shanty town, said MAP quoting an official statement.
The statement gave no word on the cause of the scuffle.
Authorities said the fire destroyed 118 tin shacks and took three hours to bring under control.
